title: BiteMatica Settings
description: Settings for the BiteMatica schematic overlay. Editable here or from the in-game Mod Menu.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the schematic overlay on or off.

renderMode.title: Render Mode
renderMode.description: 0 draws translucent blocks, 1 draws only the bounding box, 2 draws nothing.

ghostPlacement.title: Ghost Placement
ghostPlacement.description: Outlines where the build would sit in the world.

onlyExposed.title: Exposed Faces Only
onlyExposed.description: Skips fully enclosed blocks when meshing.

maxRenderBlocks.title: Render Block Cap
maxRenderBlocks.description: Upper bound on blocks meshed per frame.

maxTriangles.title: Triangle Budget
maxTriangles.description: Meshing stops and reports truncation past this many triangles.

renderDistance.title: Render Distance
renderDistance.description: Sections beyond this many blocks are not drawn; 0 disables distance culling.

layerMode.title: Layer Mode
layerMode.description: 0 all layers, 1 a single layer, 2 a range.

showOutlines.title: Block Outlines
showOutlines.description: Draw the block-edge outline over the ghost blocks.

outlineWidth.title: Outline Width
outlineWidth.description: Outline line width in pixels (0.5-8; the driver may clamp it).

polygonOffsetFactor.title: Polygon Offset Factor
polygonOffsetFactor.description: Depth-bias factor for the ghost faces, to stop z-fighting with real blocks. Negative pulls the ghost toward the camera (-8 to 0).

polygonOffsetUnits.title: Polygon Offset Units
polygonOffsetUnits.description: Depth-bias units for the ghost faces (-16 to 0).

verifyAgainstWorld.title: Verify Against World
verifyAgainstWorld.description: Colour blocks by whether the live world matches the schematic.

verifyExtras.title: Report Extra Blocks
verifyExtras.description: Also flag world blocks sitting where the schematic wants air.

verifyMismatchMode.title: Mismatch Display
verifyMismatchMode.description: 0 shows all ghost blocks, 1 shows only mismatches, 2 hides correct blocks.

verifyBlocksPerFrame.title: Verify Blocks Per Frame
verifyBlocksPerFrame.description: How many blocks the verifier checks per frame (100-200000). Larger schematics are scanned incrementally at this rate.

verifyGameVersionTag.title: Verified Game Version
verifyGameVersionTag.description: The game version the getBlock slot was confirmed against. The world source is only enabled when this matches the running version. See docs/FINDING_GETBLOCK.md.

verifyBlockSourceSlot.title: BlockSource::getBlock Slot
verifyBlockSourceSlot.description: Primary-vtable slot of the world block getter for your game build, or -1 to leave verification off. Only set this once you have confirmed the slot for your build: a wrong slot can crash the game.

panicHidden.title: Panic Hide
panicHidden.description: Hide all rendering instantly without unloading. Toggle with the H toolbar button.

uiScale.title: UI Scale
uiScale.description: Toolbar button scale. Clamped to a 1.2 minimum so touch targets stay above 48 dp.

textScale.title: Text Scale
textScale.description: Status line and panel text size.

highContrast.title: High Contrast
highContrast.description: Opaque backgrounds and maximum text contrast.

maxRenderDistance.title: Max Render Distance
maxRenderDistance.description: Blocks beyond which the overlay is not drawn; 0 means unlimited.
